title: ApeCam
tagline: Stealcam but for Ape community. Steal other videos using APE.
description: We created a Stealcam that is never done before. With the integration of ApeCoin which is our main currency and video NFTs, we became a category of our own. Any user that has an ENS is able to not only upload but also steal someone's hard work/video nft and mint as long as they pay more ApeCoin.
how_its_made:
We created a custom ERC721 token that allows maximum one NFT to be minted per block. Then, using APE tokens, anyone can steal NFTs from each other by paying more than what the previous person stole it for. 
We used Livepeer to handle the uploading and playback of NFTs to IPFS. We will token-gate it by checking if the user owns the NFT or not.
